# What's My Tax Rate

> A free, interactive tool that shows your real effective federal, state, and FICA tax rate for 2026 — not just your marginal rate.

## Key Topics
- Federal effective vs. marginal tax rate explained
- FICA (Social Security + Medicare) tax breakdown
- Paycheck withholding vs. actual tax liability
- Historical US federal tax rates (1955–2026)
- Tax sheltering: 401(k), IRA, HSA impact
- Itemized vs. standard deduction comparison
- Tax credits vs. deductions
- State-level Social Security taxation
- Puerto Rico Act 60 tax rules

## Primary URL
https://whatsmytaxrate.com/

## Data Sources
- IRS Publication 15-T (2026)
- IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-28
- Tax Policy Center Historical Tables
